features.name: meta__timestamp
features.description: Canonical UTC timestamp for the record, serialized as ISO-8601.

features.name: meta__sequence_id
features.description: Deterministic ingestion sequence id that is monotonically non-decreasing.

features.name: meta__source_feed
features.description: Feed source identifier indicating the observed market data channel.

features.name: meta__data_latency_ms
features.description: Latency between source feed timestamp and ingestion timestamp measured in milliseconds.

features.name: meta__feature_confidence
features.description: Per-record feature confidence score derived from data health signals.

features.name: meta__staleness_flag
features.description: Flag indicating whether the record was deemed stale at ingestion.

features.name: meta__ingest_quality_score
features.description: Aggregate ingest quality score derived from schema, null, and range checks.

features.name: meta__feature_mask_count
features.description: Count of features imputed or default-filled during ingest validation.
